title: After the Free Period: What Changes and What Stays
summary: After the free period, the monthly maintenance fee changes to $25.00 and billing updates automatically—appearing on your next statement after the transition. Interest continues accruing at 1.25%, and existing users, cards, controls, and analytics stay active; eligibility (company age threshold 4) is evaluated only when the account is opened.
faqs: What is the monthly maintenance fee after the free period?

Does interest continue to accrue after the free period? At what rate?
